name: Brave Web Search
description: Direct REST API connector for Brave Search. Returns structured web results, snippets, URLs and optional freshness filtering. Requires a Brave Search API subscription key.

credentialFields.label: Brave Search API key
credentialFields.help: Create a key in the Brave Search API dashboard. Keep it private.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web with Brave and return ranked results with titles, URLs, snippets and metadata. Use this for current information and source discovery.

query.description: Search terms or a natural-language question.

permissions.description: Sends the search query and configured search options to the provider over HTTPS.
Reads the search result titles, snippets, URLs and metadata returned by the provider.
